messages.subject: Scaling image (plots) to data space.
parts:
First, I'm using shiny_0.11.1.9003 on a MAC, but I think the OS doesn't matter in this situation.

In the help page for imageOutput(), it says: 
"For plotOutput, the coordinates will be sent scaled to the data space, if possible. (At the moment, plots generated by base graphics support this scaling, although plots generated by grid or ggplot2 do not.) "

In a previous version of shiny (I don't remember which one), my png files generated using ggplot2 scaled to the data space very well. I have controls that set the width, height, and resolution and all worked well. When the .png file is copied to a markdown file and then converted to a .docx (using pandoc), the sizes and resolution are respected perfectly. 

When I upgraded shiny_0.11.1.9003 I made some changes to my ui, switching to fixedPage which has worked very well in my case for all elements of the layout except the plot outputs. 

Question: The help pages say "At the moment...", does this mean that the issue is being addressed? Does anyone have advice for me as to how to get this to work? I do need the images to be scaled in the browser. 

Thanks!  Nick.
